CFPB to regulate big tech digital wallets ex. crypto. Charles Schwab to directly offer crypto to clients. Trump Media exploring crypto payment platform. FTX to start creditor repayments from Mar 2025. Circle’s USDC to launch on Aptos. WisdomTree launches XRP ETP.
